name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.82
description: Enlarge a single kiosk camera in place while keeping the shared live player connected.
releaseNotes: 2.20.82 adds click, keyboard and Escape access to enlarged live camera tiles in both browser and Linux kiosk.
